# Third-party licenses

The LSP Parametric Equalizer, framework, DSP libraries, toolkit, and Windows graphics modules are pinned in manifest.json and are licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later. The full GNU license texts are in COPYING and COPYING.LESSER.

The CLAP API headers are pinned to free-audio/clap 1.2.6. Their MIT license is included at clap/include/clap/LICENSE. The LSP third-party source archive contains other upstream notices; its exact archive is recorded in manifest.json.
